articles.title: Why Your Taco Tuesday Might Cost More: Mexico's Food Prices Are Soaring!
articles.summary: Imagine paying almost all your money just for food! In Mexico, rising fuel and fertilizer costs are making tomatoes, beef, and chiles super expensive. Families are cutting back, and some spend 70% of their income on meals.

articles.title: Sizzling! UK Hits 30.5°C and It's Only Going to Get Hotter!
articles.summary: The UK just had its hottest day of the year at 30.5°C in Kent—and it might break a 1944 record! Heat health alerts are out, and Monday could hit 33°C. Even Scotland will warm up. Don't forget your sunscreen!

articles.title: Top U.S. Spy Boss Tulsi Gabbard Steps Down for a Heartbreaking Reason
articles.summary: Tulsi Gabbard, the U.S. Director of National Intelligence, resigned to care for her husband, who has a rare bone cancer. She also made headlines for showing up at an FBI raid on an election office and opposing the Iran war.
